title: Object Storage: cool credit — remaining overcharge
content:
For Object Storage cool credit, subtract the approved corrected net target from the original amount plus signed prior correction credits and debits, then floor at zero.

## Basis Q&A

What determines cool credit in this situation? Subtract the approved corrected net target from the original amount plus signed prior correction credits and debits, then floor at zero.

## Hypothetical cool credit — remaining overcharge case

For this cool credit — remaining overcharge example, assume hypothetical original amount USD 80, prior signed correction credits negative USD 9, prior correction debits USD 4 and approved corrected target USD 60. The remaining overcharge is USD 15.
